svg.aria-label: How the recording desk is wired. My laptop connects to an Anker Prime TB5 dock with one Thunderbolt 5 cable, both ways. The Cam Link 4K and the Wave:3 MK.2 send video and audio into the dock, and the dock drives the Elgato Prompter screen. The Sony ZV-E10 feeds the Cam Link over HDMI. The dock, the camera on its dummy battery, the softbox and the spotlight all sit on one Sengled smart plug that Home Assistant switches, and it has never read more than about 112W.
